title: Burst pipe? Do this first

scenes.say: A pipe just burst in your house.
scenes.visual: water spraying from a broken copper pipe under a kitchen sink, water on the floor

scenes.say: First, shut off the main water valve.
scenes.visual: a hand turning a round main water shutoff valve on a pipe in a basement

scenes.say: It is usually where the water line enters the house.
scenes.visual: a basement wall where a water pipe comes through the foundation, dim light

scenes.say: Stay clear of water near outlets and appliances.
scenes.visual: water pooling on a basement floor near a wall outlet, seen from a distance

scenes.say: Move your valuables out of the way.
scenes.visual: hands lifting a cardboard box off a wet basement floor

scenes.say: Then call and tell us what is leaking and where.
scenes.visual: a hand holding a phone in a dim hallway at night
a clean white plumbing service van parked on a quiet small-town street at dusk, warm lights in the houses

caption: Burst pipe? Shut off the main valve, stay away from water near electricity, then call. Every call is answered.
